task_title: Review the environment-bound developmental baseline checkpoint
task_body: Independently examine the frozen bound-baseline report, driver, harness, source inventories and verifier for evidence or methodology gaps. Check the explicit environment contract, complete path/hash/mode checks, allocation attribution and honest exclusion of current comparison and native qualification. Return actionable source-evidence findings without modifying production source or frozen evidence.
acceptance: Report Critical/Important/Minor findings with concrete evidence. Distinguish baseline preparation from R19 completion; do not issue a formal implementation SHIP verdict. Write only bound-baseline-checkpoint-source-review.md outside the frozen measurement directory.
